items.en: Russia shows Pantsir-S1M on Belarusian MZKT-7930-312 chassis at Tsentr-2026, first official confirmation of the configuration
items.nl: Rusland toont Pantsir-S1M op Wit-Russisch MZKT-7930-312-chassis tijdens Tsentr-2026: eerste officiële bevestiging van de configuratie
items.sEn: During the strategic exercise Tsentr-2026, Russia showed an upgraded Pantsir-S1M gun-and-missile air defence system mounted on a Belarusian MZKT-7930-312 chassis, Defence Blog reports. It is the first official confirmation of this configuration, which until now was known only from a leaked supply contract and from one…

items.en: Russian combined strike on Kyiv and Kyiv Oblast, 29-30 Sep: Zircon/Oniks, Iskander and 188 drones, energy infrastructure the main target

items.en: Night of 28-29 Sep: Russia strikes Ukraine with a Zircon, two ballistic missiles and 152 drones; Air Force claims 109 downed, two unexploded ballistic warheads defused in Kyiv
items.nl: Nacht van 28 op 29 sep: Rusland valt Oekraïne aan met een Zircon, twee ballistische raketten en 152 drones; luchtmacht claimt 109 neergehaald, twee niet-ontplofte ballistische gevechtskoppen in Kyiv onschadelijk gemaakt
items.sEn: Russia attacked Ukraine overnight on 28-29 September 2026 with one Zircon/Oniks anti-ship missile, two Iskander-M or S-400 ballistic missiles (launched from Kursk Oblast) and 152 drones, according to Ukraine's Air Force. The drones were Shahed types (82 of them jet-powered), Gerbera attack drones and Parodiya decoys,…
